sections.title: Valuation Insights
sections.text: Costco delivered a year‑over‑year revenue increase of [[COST.ratio.revenue_growth]], reflecting solid top‑line expansion. The operating margin of [[COST.ratio.operating_margin]] indicates modest profitability on sales, while the return on average equity of [[COST.ratio.return_on_average_equity]] demonstrates a high efficiency of capital deployment. Debt financing remains low, with a debt‑to‑equity ratio of [[COST.ratio.debt_to_equity]], suggesting a strong balance‑sheet profile. Free cash flow of [[COST.ratio.free_cash_flow]] shows ample cash generation after capital spending, supporting dividend sustainability and share repurchases. The annual price‑earnings multiple of [[COST.ratio.price_earnings]] is elevated, implying that the market is pricing in growth expectations relative to earnings.

insight.text: The return on average equity is a key driver of valuation because it captures how effectively the company converts net income into shareholder value relative to its equity base.
